notes: Original locators refer to p. 2/Table 1 or Table 2; retrieved Sciencexpress version places both tables on PDF p. 6. Table 2 provides adjusted means, not omega squared; the matching Table 1 condition effect is extracted. Requested b identifies the ART main effect on the indicated replication page. This is a lifetime-exposure association rather than the original condition effect; target equivalence is not established. Authors report ART as a significant predictor, but do not give an explicit replication-success verdict for this specific association; success is left null.
